# Whistic

> Primary category: [vendor-risk](../categories/vendor-risk.md).

**One-liner** — Two-sided vendor security assessment: buyers run AI-assisted vendor assessments, vendors publish proactive security profiles to a shared network — questionnaire automation as the product.

**What it does** — Automates the security-questionnaire loop of TPRM from both sides. Buy side: request, score, and track vendor assessments. Sell side: publish a "Whistic Profile" (SOC 2, ISO certs, CAIQ/SIG answers) once and share on demand. The Whistic Vendor Security Network claims 40,000+ on-demand vendor profiles; current positioning (2026) is AI-first — LLM-drafted questionnaire answers and automated assessment review ("Whistic AI").

**Naming / provenance** — Founded 2015, Provo, Utah. No renames found.

**Ownership & viability** — `independent`, VC-backed. $35M Series B announced 2022-06-07 led by **JMI Equity** (Album VC, Emergence, Forgepoint, FJ Labs participating); ~$51M total. No later round or acquirer found as of 2026-07-27 — smaller war chest than category neighbors, so acquisition risk is worth watching in a consolidating TPRM market.

**Positioning & differentiators** — Questionnaire/assessment-exchange specialist, vs workflow suites ([processunity](processunity.md), [venminder](venminder.md)) and outside-in ratings ([bitsight](bitsight.md), [securityscorecard](securityscorecard.md), [black-kite](black-kite.md)). The network model (assess once, share many) and AI questionnaire automation are the differentiators; SecurityScorecard's HyperComply buy (2025) put the ratings vendors into the same questionnaire-automation lane.

**Who should choose them / anti-fit** — Fits teams drowning in inbound/outbound security questionnaires who want the exchange model. Anti-fit: firms wanting full vendor-lifecycle workflow or continuous external monitoring — Whistic complements rather than replaces those.

**Known weaknesses / gotchas** — Narrower scope than TPRM suites; funding scale suggests possible consolidation target. AI-answered questionnaires cut both ways — your vendors' answers may be LLM-drafted too.

**Deployment & data handling** — SaaS. Details unverified.

**Integrations & partnerships** — Unverified.

**Compliance & FS traction** — Unverified; no named FS customers found.

**Commercial** — Pricing not public; subscription, separate buy-side/sell-side packaging.
